season.evidence: Stored Oct-May agrees with guide-service and forum reports: climbed in November and in spring up to mid-May; always thinner and harder in fall than spring; a mid-May report called it near the end of the season.

facts.text: In mid-May the lowest ice below the crux pillar can have water running beneath it, and the pillar itself keeps streaming.
Ice screws take poorly in the aerated pillar ice of mid-May; pickets are the protection that works, including on the upper snowfield, where rock gear is of no use.
By mid-May the route is near the end of its season; the exit snowfield and the walk down were easy.
